tolerance_level.description: The fault tolerance level (0-255) specifying the maximum number of errors permitted in approximate matching.

exact_mode.description: If true, use exact matching and disable wildcards '*' and '?'.

case_sensitive.description: If true, perform a case-sensitive search.

print_tolerance.description: If true, print the tolerance level before each man page name.

manpath.description: List of directories to search for man pages, overriding the default MANPATH.
